note: Eight local roles, each named once, with the identity the operating system can actually check. PLATFORM_KEY_AND_PRIVILEGE_MATRIX.md carried six process rows and omitted the privileged supervisor and the interactive shell — the two roles that most need one, since the supervisor is the only component that runs with elevated privilege and the shell is the only one that takes arbitrary operator input. A role absent from this file has no declared capability, and a capability nothing declares is one nothing can refuse.

data_classes.transcript-content: Prompts, responses, code, diffs, tool contents, filenames, paths and project names. AGENTS.md forbids this crossing the device boundary under any circumstance.
data_classes.normalized-events: Deterministic accounting events derived from observation, carrying counts and identifiers but no content.
data_classes.safe-claim: A signed claim ready for submission. Fixed-schema aggregate accounting only.
data_classes.lifecycle-metadata: Service state, configuration and audit metadata.
data_classes.release-metadata: TUF metadata, signatures and release manifests.
data_classes.operator-input: Interactive commands typed by the person at the machine.
